title: OpenClaw Corpus PE Source Mappings
description: The generated PE INTEGRATIONS_CONFIG source-mapping artifact (pe-integration/corpus.pe-source-mappings.json). One entry per write-back agent, registering the completion sensor that carries that agent's response into the reserved completion band so PE can ingest it and RE can read it. Written by domain_sweep.py --all --write. This artifact is the completion axis; it is not the same identity as the per-machine input-analyst agents in agents/INDEX.json, and the two are not interchangeable.

generatedFrom.description: Domain selector the sweep ran with; '*' for the whole corpus.

reservedBand.description: [low, high] offsets of the reserved completion band. Every region must fall inside it, and it must sit above the corpus maximum offset so no machine can collide with a completion.

count.description: Must equal the length of sourceMappings; a stale count means the artifact was hand-edited.

sensorId.description: acp.openclaw.<machine>.<agent>.completion. Note the agent segment is kebab-cased here while the sibling `agent` field is snake_cased; consumers joining on agent identity must normalize.

machine.description: Machine key. Derived from the machine file stem for most entries and from the normalized display name for a few, so a consumer resolving this against the corpus must try both conventions.

agent.description: Agent family (role level), not the per-machine input-analyst agentId from agents/INDEX.json. Must be a family declared for `domain` in the corpus domain-registry.

extract.description: One JSON pointer per element of region, in element order. Pointer count and region.length must agree or the completion writes a different number of values than the region holds.
